definitions: A hairstyle in which the hair is cut evenly all around the head, typically to chin-length.
A small, round weight or plumb attached to a line.
A shilling (a former British coin worth twelve pence).
A group of bells, especially in change ringing.
examples: He gave a quick bob of his head.
She got a new bob for the summer.
The bob of the pendulum swung steadily.
That will cost you a bob or two.
The campanologists rang a bob major.
They sped down the track in a bob.
